title: Federico III of Naples to the Catholic Monarchs, San Germano, 11 Jan 1497, in Joan Ram Escrivà's cipher no. 1: BnF Espagnol 318 no. 5, ff. 5-6v (catalogue item 9)

documents.route: Federico III of Naples, San Germano -> Ferdinand and Isabella

plaintext.source: Ivan Parisi, 'Un cifrario in prestito ...', Studi di storia medioevale e di diplomatica n.s. IV (2020) 157-177 (whole letter printed)

transcription.source: Parisi 2020; the Gallica images (full/f005r-f006v.jpg in targets/esp318/) viewed here
transcription.notes: Only the nomenclator groups Parisi lists were checked against the leaf; no transcription made here.

system.summary: The cipher issued to Joan Ram Escrivà, Spanish ambassador at Naples (Escrivà no. 1; Parisi 2004 app. II): a sign alphabet with a nomenclator of letter groups with initials p, q, r, s, t, v, x (qav de, vee que, xer/xoq Vuestras Altezas ...).
system.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from esp318 (the whole volume) under the one-key rule. The other ciphered letters of Espagnol 318 have their own entries: esp318 (no. 92), esp318no95, esp318no93.

prior_solution.where: Parisi 2020 (open access, DOI 10.54103/2611-318X/14378): identification of the cipher and the whole Italian text

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Mapped the five ciphered letters of Espagnol 318 from the manifest and notice; no. 5 is ff. 5-6v (canvases 32-35).
Searching the shelfmark found Parisi 2020, who identified the cipher as Escrivà's and printed the whole letter; the nomenclator groups he lists were checked against the leaf at 3000 px and match.

Split from the former whole-volume target esp318 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): no. 5 is in Escrivà's cipher, a different key from the other ciphered letters of the volume. Own folder, profile, page and ledgers.

outcome.method_basis: Ivan Parisi identified the cipher as Escrivà's and printed the whole letter (2020); the text is his, and only his nomenclator list was checked against the leaf here.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Parisi 2020 prints the whole letter; not counted here (no transcription)
outcome.notes: Nothing about the text is new. The project's part was finding Parisi's article from the shelfmark and checking his nomenclator values on the leaf.

credits.note: identified Escrivà's cipher and printed the whole letter, SSMD n.s. IV (2020) 157-177; the text here is his
